newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish bonds end softer, seen paring gap to Bunds.
newsitem.headline: Finnish bonds end softer, seen paring gap to Bunds.

text.p: 1615/1415 GMT - Bonds end a shade weaker with the gap over Bunds widening though dealers said they see scope seen for the spread to narrow. Markets cautious before U.S. 30-yr bond sale later on Thursday, dealers say. Finnish 2004 bonds well-sold at auction. Markka down vs mark on foreign DEM buying, dealers say.
*FIM-06 yld pct 5.91 vs 5.89 *06 gap over Bund bps 35 vs 30
*FIM-04 yld pct 5.49 vs 5.47 *FIM-99 yld pct 3.59 vs 3.55
*Mar FRAs pct 3.13 vs 3.13 *Dec FRAs pct 3.57 vs 3.56
Over three billion markka ($604 million) worth of the 2004 bonds was issued to the market in an auction, which dealers said went well.
The markka softened versus the mark for the second consecutive day, mainly on heavy foreign mark purchases for markka, dealers said.
But the slight markka weakness was viewed as temporary. Dealers saw DEM/FIM moving in a 2.930 to 2.960 range in the very near term, with potential to fall towards 2.90 in coming weeks.
